body.name: direct marked-factorial tail-calibration handle
body.construction: Use Catoni's scalar bounded-influence transform only as an algebraic score template inside independent perturbation blocks of the marked factorial lift before category aggregation. Derive the required score inequalities directly from \(ass:conditional\text{-}fourth\text{-}moment\), including cells of zero or arbitrarily small conditional variance; use observable leave-block perturbations and exponential score inversion to define \(\widehat R_{\mathrm L}\) as the smallest radius whose two-sided score is at most \(\alpha/4\), with no cellwise union bound and no post hoc median wrapper.
